title: Last-occurrence index map
prompt: Implement `static Dictionary<string, int> LastIndex(IEnumerable<string> items)` — each distinct item mapped to the index of its **last** occurrence. Null/empty yields an empty dictionary.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Walk once with the running index; each assignment naturally overwrites with the latest position.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Zero is a real index here — the empty-dictionary contract keeps 0 from meaning "missing".
